implementation_statement: Identity provider accounts are created, disabled, and removed automatically from the HR system feed.

implementation_statement: The identity provider locks accounts for 15 minutes after 10 failed sign-ins. evidence: EV-002 (identity provider policy); EV-007 (HMI lockout setting); tailoring record (section 10.1)

implementation_statement: Office workstations lock after 10 minutes. Shared production-floor terminals use badge tap to switch users. Gap: engineering workstations and SCADA consoles at both plants stay unlocked without a documented compensating control.
evidence: EV-010 (endpoint configuration report); EV-007 (engineering workstation and SCADA console settings)

implementation_statement: The records application ends idle sessions after 15 minutes and the identity provider session lifetime is 12 hours.
evidence: EV-009 (records application settings); EV-002 (identity provider session policy)

implementation_statement: Workforce remote access uses the identity-aware VPN with MFA. Plant 1 vendors use the remote access gateway with MFA, named accounts, and session recording. evidence: EV-016 (gateway configuration); EV-017 (Plant 2 VPN and modem records)

implementation_statement: Plant 1 gateway sessions are recorded and logged. Gap: Plant 2 vendor sessions are not logged or monitored.
evidence: EV-016 (gateway session logs); EV-017 (Plant 2 VPN with no session log)

implementation_statement: Remote access sessions are encrypted (TLS 1.2 or higher and IPsec); the Plant 2 modem link is encrypted by the contractor, but the company cannot verify its settings.
evidence: EV-016 (VPN and gateway configuration); EV-017 (modem settings not visible)

implementation_statement: Plant 1 remote access to OT has one managed access point (the gateway). Gap: Plant 2 has two unmanaged paths (integrator VPN and the cellular modem).
evidence: EV-014 (network diagram, Plant 1); EV-017 (Plant 2 remote paths)

Annual awareness training and phishing simulations reach the about 560 identity provider account holders (June 2026 click rate 9.4%). Gap: production, sanitation, and maintenance workers and agency temporaries receive food defense awareness at orientation but no security awareness (EV-034).
Planned: insider threat awareness in supervisor training and in the food defense awareness module (tampering signs, reporting) by 2027-03-31.

HACCP training for FSQA staff meets 9 CFR 417.7. Gap: controls engineers and the OT security engineer have no OT security training; MES approvers have no training on recognizing suspicious formulation changes.

Event types are defined for the identity provider, cloud, firewalls, email, and EDR. Gap: no defined events for SCADA, historians, the MES, HMIs, engineering workstations, or the refrigeration controllers.
IT logs record who, what, when, and where. Gap: HMI and Plant 2 historian events cannot identify the person because logins are shared.

control_name: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
implementation_statement: The MSSP reviews IT logs 24x7. Gaps: Plant 1 passive OT sensor alerts are reviewed weekly on a local console; MES and historian audit logs are not reviewed.
IT log correlation is automated in the SIEM. Gap: OT sources are not integrated.
Plant 1 OT servers synchronize to the DMZ time source. Gap: Plant 2 HMIs and the historian drift by up to 6 minutes, which undermines the "time recorded" element of CCP records.
evidence: EV-025 (time source configuration); EV-063 (Plant 2 drift check)

implementation_statement: SIEM data and the cloud log archive are write-once. Gap: the Plant 2 historian audit trail is disabled, and Plant 1 historian and MES audit logs can be cleared by engineering accounts.
SIEM data is kept 1 year searchable. Gap: firewall and remote access gateway logs at the plants keep 30 to 90 days; no retention is set for OT event logs.
Audit records are generated by the identity provider, cloud, firewalls, EDR, and the records application. Gap: OT components do not generate the events defined in AU-2.
evidence: EV-024 (source configuration); EV-009 (records application audit trail)

implementation_statement: Controls are assessed each year by the co-sourced internal audit firm. The 2026 assessment covered 32 PPCM controls (P07).

evidence: EV-029 (internal audit engagement and reporting line)
